title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Guyyaa lamaa hojiin: Gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo
bridge: Afaan Oromo, guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaa ta'e jedhanii (hablé, comí, viví). Afaan Ingilizii, gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo -ed jedhanii (talk → talked), garuu gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo barbaachisaanii danda'an qabda (go → went). Afaan Ingilizii, guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan (I went, you went, he went), Afaan Oromo garuu barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan (fui, fuiste, fue). Haala dhiiseefi 'did' kan hin kennamne dhufuu!
rule: Afaan Ingilizii guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan. Gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo, -ed jedhanii (work → worked, play → played). Gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo 'e' jedhanii, -d jedhanii (live → lived); gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo qonsonant + 'y' jedhanii, 'y' jedhanii 'i' jedhaniiti -ed jedhanii (study → studied). Gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo barbaachisaanii danda'an qabda (see → saw, eat → ate) haala dhiiseefi kennitan. Afaan Ingilizii, guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan 'did' jedhanii + gaaffiiwwan lamaa hojjetan qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan (I didn't go, Did you see?). Guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan 'did' jedhanii hin kennamne. Guyyaa lamaa hojiin qabsoo barbaachisaanii hundaaf kennitan 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in 2010' jedhanii.

title: Present Progressive (Laalee Guutee)
bridge: Ingliffii keessatti, laalee guutee (am/is/are + qabxii -ing) akka ataani dhaabbataa ta'e jechuudha. Afaan Oromoo keessatti, nama laalee xixinnoo akkasumas laalee guutee akkasumas isaaniiwwan qabanne (''aan naa qabanna'' vs ''naa qabanna''). Gahiisa uumamuu kanarraa ta’u malee, warri afaan Oromoo qabduutti qabxii fayyii ''to be'' isaan hin kennamne akkasumas laalee xixinnoo fi laalee guutee isaaniiwwan qabuu hin qabne. Ingliffii afaan Oromootti kan biraa, qabicha xixinnoota (laalee xixinnoo) fi qabicha guutee (laalee guutee) hin isaaniiwwan qabne.
rule: Laalee guutee qabxii ''to be'' (am, is, are) + qabxii uumamuu fi -ing dhaabbolaa ta'e jechuudha. Akkasumas: 1) qabichaan akkas ta'e jechuudhaan dhaabbataa ta'e (''I am reading now''), 2) qabichaan akkas ta'e jechuudhaan dhaabbataa ta'e (''She is working in Madrid these days''), fi 3) baay'ee (''We are meeting at 5''). Qabichaan isaaniiwwan qabuu hin qabne (like, want, know, prefer) haala malee tokko tokko akkas ta'e jechuudha. Seensa qabicha ''not'' fayyii qabxii fayyii deebi'aa (''I am not sleeping''), fi galma qabxii fayyii deebi'aa (''Are you listening?''). Afaan Oromoo keessatti, laalee guutee (qabxii ''be'' + qabxii -ing) akkasumas ta'e, haala malee Ingliffii afaan Oromootti kan biraa, qabichaan akkas ta'e jechuudhaan dhaabbataa ta'e.

title: Future with going to / 'Going to' hin yaa'ibaa
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, seenaa ishee itti dhufan haala dhaabaa mana qabdu akkasumas 'ir a + infinitivo' jedhanii mana qabdu argisiisu. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, 'be going to + verbo' jedhanii 'ir a + infinitivo' hin yaanee dhaabaa akkasumas isaaniif tokko irra deebi'ee dubbii qabduu kan danda'u: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti dubbii 'to be' (am/is/are) hin yaaneeh 'going to' hin kennamuu hin dandeessu; haa ta'u malee, Afaan Ispaanii keessatti kanatti hin jiru. Akkasumas, 'going to' seenaa akkasumas yaadaa hin yaanee, seenaa hojii barbaachisaa hin yaanuu (kanatti 'will' hin yaanu).
rule: Futuurii 'going to' hin yaanuu qabduu: macaafaa + dubbii 'to be' (am/is/are) + 'going to' + dubbii hin yaanee. Seeraa itti fufi: 'I am going to travel' (seenaa mana dhaabaa). Seeraa ishee hin danda'amu: 'I am not going to travel' (seenaa mana hin dhaabne). Seeraa walitti dhiisuu: 'Are you going to travel?' (maaltu seenaa dhaabaa?). Isaaniif tokko tokko irra deebi'ee dubbii qabduu akkasumas 'I'm going to', 'You're going to' jedhanii mana qabdu. Isaaniif tokko tokko irra deebi'ee dubbii qabduu: 1) Seenaa akkasumas yaadaa (I'm going to study medicine), 2) Seenaa hojii barbaachisaa (Look at those clouds! It's going to rain). Isaaniif tokko tokko irra deebi'ee dubbii qabduu hin danda'amu (kanatti 'will' hin yaanu: 'I'll help you'). Dubbii 'going to' hin yaaneeh dubbii 'to be' hin yaane dhaabaa.

title: Simple Future (will) / Gahee Wallaa (will)
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, gahee wallaa qabuuf jechaa ‘ir a + infinitivo’ jechuudhaan hin jiru. Afaan Ingilizitti, gahee wallaa qabuu ‘will + fiilichi guyyaa’ jechuudhaan dha. Afaan Ispeenichaa tokkoo miti, fiilichi guyyaa qabduu kan arratti hin jiru; fiilichi guyyaa miti. Gahiichaa tokko qofatu ‘will’ hin guyyachini fiilichi guyyaa qabduu, ‘to’ jechuu jechuu hin jiru.
rule: Gahee wallaa ‘will’ jechuu qabduu fiilichi guyyaa qabduu ‘will’ (jechuu ‘ll’ jechuu) + fiilichi guyyaa qabduu. Fiilichi guyyaa qabduu qabduu (he will go, she will go, we will go). Afaan Oromootti, ‘will not’ (won’t) jechuudhaan hin jiru. Gahee wallaa qabuu ‘will’ jechuu qabduu fiilichi guyyaa qabduu. ‘Will’ jechuu gahee wallaa qabuu, gahee wallaa qabuu, gahee wallaa qabuu, gahee wallaa qabuu, gahee wallaa qabuu jechuudhaan hin jiru. Gahee wallaa qabuu ‘tomorrow, next week, soon, etc.’ jechuudhaan hin jiru. Afaan Oromootti, ‘will not’ jechuu ‘won’t’ jechuudhaan hin jiru.

title: Comparatives and Superlatives / Birraafi godheefi sirnaa
bridge: Afaan Ispeenichii, birraafi godhaa qixxa’uu ‘más’ jechuu ‘menos’ hin miidhamne (más alto, el más alto). Afaan Ingilizii, lamaan tokko qabna: adjiibii sirrii (silla baafachuu, gara lamaan tokkoo) ‘-er’ jechuu ‘-est’ hin kennamne (tall → taller → tallest), adjiibii godhee (silla lamaan) ‘more’ jechuu ‘most’ hin kennamne (beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful). Gahi tokko: ‘more tall’ jechuu ‘más alto’ hin jedhi — kun Afaan Ingilizii dhihaa ta’ee hin qabne. Godheefi sirnaa ‘the’ hin qabne (the tallest), Afaan Ispeenichii ‘el’ hin qabne.
rule: Birraafi godhaa sirrii: Adjiibii sirrii (silla tokko jechuu gara lamaan tokkoo ‘happy’, ‘simple’) ‘-er’ hin kennamne (fast → faster). Adjiibii godhee (silla lamaan) ‘more’ hin kennamne (more expensive). Godheefi sirnaa: ‘-est’ (the fastest) jechuu ‘most’ (the most expensive). Adjiibii silla lallookuu -y jechuudhaan -ier jechuu -iest hin kennamne (happy → happier → happiest). Akkaan tokko: good/well → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → farther/further → farthest/furthest. ‘Than’ birraafi godhaa (She is taller than me) jechuu ‘the’ + godhaa sirnaa (He is the best). ‘More’ jechuu ‘-er’ hin kennamne, ‘most’ jechuu ‘-est’ hin kennamne.

title: Modal Verbs: must, have to, should
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti kanneen fayyyadamaa fi maqaa dursuu keessatti walitti dhuunfatu qabna. Kanneen 'must' fi 'have to' irra deebii tokko irra jiraatanii, 'should' jedhanis maqaa dursuu keessatti walitti dhuunfatu qabna. Haala malee, kanneen fayyyadamaa keessatti 's' hin qabne garuu, kanneen fayyyadamaa keessatti 'to' hin qabne garuu, 'have to' fi 'need to' jedhanii 'to' qabna.
rule: Kanneen fayyyadamaa keessatti fayyyadamaa (must, have to), maqaa dursuu (should) fi haawaasa (need to) qabna. Fayyuramaa keessatti: macaafaa + kanneen fayyyadamaa + fayyyadamaa eegama (hanga 'to' hin kennamne garuu, 'have to' fi 'need to' jedhanii 'to' kennamne). 'Must' fayyyadamaa eegamaadhaan qabna, 'have to' fayyyadamaa eegamaadhaan qabna, 'should' maqaa dursuu qabna. Gaggabaa: must not (mustn't) fayyyadamaa eegamaadhaan qabna, don't/doesn't have to fayyyadamaa eegamaadhaan qabna, shouldn't maqaa dursuu qabna. Gawwada: kanneen fayyyadamaa macaafaa fi qabxii keessatti walitti dhuunfatu qabna: 'Should I...?' ama 'Do I have to...?'. 'Must' mana dhiisee hin qabne garuu, 'had to' qabna. 'Have to' dhiisee, mana dhiisee (had to) fi murtii (will have to) qabna. 'Should' mana dhiisee hin qabne garuu, 'should have + past participle' jedhanii fayyyadamaa eegamaadhaan qabna, kana hili B1 duraa jira.

title: Reflexive Verbs / Fidaa irra deebi’aa
bridge: Afaan Oromootti fidaa irra deebi’aa hinka dhaabbataa ta’an ittiin hojjatan (kana godhe, kana bahe), garuu Afaan Ingilizii keessatti fidaa kanaa miti. Hama dhuma fidaa Afaan Oromoos irra deebi’aa kan ta’e Afaan Ingilizii keessatti fidaa dhaabachaa ta’e (I get up, I shower). Afaan Ingilizii keessumis, fidaa irra deebi’aa (myself, yourself, etc.) yeroo kamiyyuu irraa fidaa deebisuufi dhaabachuu danda’an kan ta’e hanga ilaalchisee, Afaan Oromoositti wajjin wal hin qabne. ‘me’ Afaan Oromoos ‘me’ Afaan Ingilizii keessatti wal hin godhin, ‘me’ fidaa dhaabachaa, hin taaneef.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, fidaa irra deebi’aa fidaa + fidaa irra deebi’aa (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves) kan ta’e. Fidaa kamiyyuu irraa fidaa deebisuufi dhaabachuu danda’an yeroo kan ta’e. Garuu hama tokko tokko fidaa Afaan Oromoos irra deebi’aa kan ta’e Afaan Ingilizii keessatti fidaa irra deebi’aa hin kennamne: get up, wake up, shave, shower, dress, feel, etc. Misolaa: I get up at seven (no 'I get myself up'). I feel happy (no 'I feel myself happy'). Fidaa irra deebi’aa kamiyyuu irraa fidaa deebisuufi dhaabachuu danda’an yookiin dhihaatanis dhaabachuu danda’a. A2 level keessatti, fidaa irra deebi’aa dhaabbataa ta’an ittiin hojjatan (get up, wash, dress) fi ilaalchaa ‘enjoy oneself’ kana ‘behave oneself’ keessatti dhiisee. ‘myself’ fidaa kamiyyuu hin taane; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘I’ ta’e.

title: Object Pronouns / Qajeelfannoo baa'ee fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, qajeelfannoo baa'ee fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (in, si, isaani, isaanich, isaana) barbaachisaa akkaan verb-iin kan danda'an, laakin Afaan Ingilizii, object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) hin jiru verb-iin dha. Akkasumas, Afaan Oromo, qajeelfannoo baa'ee fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa isaani fi isaanich jedhanii barbaachisaa akkaan verb-iin kan danda'an, laakin Afaan Ingilizii, him/her/them jedhanii barbaachisaa akkaan verb-iin kan danda'an. Dhugaa: Afaan Ingilizii, qajeelfannoo hin qabdu yoo kan ta'e, akkasumas 'lo' jedhani 'it' jedhani hin qabdu.
rule: Qajeelfannoo baa'ee fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa Afaan Ingilizii: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Kana malee, qajeelfannoo baa'ee (baa'ee) fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (gabaabsaa) qajeelfannoo baa'ee (baa'ee) fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (gabaabsaa) qajeelfannoo baa'ee (baa'ee) fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (gabaabsaa) qajeelfannoo baa'ee (baa'ee) fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (gabaabsaa) qajeelfannoo baa'ee (baa'ee) fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa (gabaabsaa). Qajeelfannoo baa'ee fi qajeelfannoo gabaabsaa him/her jedhanii barbaachisaa akkaan verb-iin kan danda'an, 'ello' jedhani 'it' jedhani hin qabdu.

Dhugaa: qajeelfannoo baa'ee = her/him/them; qajeelfannoo baa'ee = she/he/they.

title: Frequency Adverbs / Adverbios de frecuencia
bridge: Afaan Espanii keessatti, haala dhibbii ‘siempre’ kana ‘nunca’ hin jiru ‘Siempre como fruta’, garuu Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti seenaa qajeelfama dhiisuu danda'a: haala dhibbii ‘I always eat fruit’ hin jiru ‘to be’ keessatti ‘I am always happy’ hin jiru. Afaan Espanii keessatti ‘nunca’ hin jiru ‘don’t’ hin jiru, garuu Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti ‘never’ hin jiru ‘don’t’ hin jiru.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti haala dhibbii (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) haala dhibbii ‘She often reads.’ hin jiru ‘to be’ (am/is/are) keessatti ‘He is always late.’ hin jiru. ‘Do you usually drink coffee?’ ‘I don’t often go out.’ ‘sometimes’ fi ‘usually’ ‘Sometimes I walk to work’ / ‘I walk to work sometimes’. ‘Never’, ‘rarely’ fi ‘seldom’ ‘not’ hin jiran. ‘Never’ ‘I never smoke’ (no 'I don’t never smoke'). ‘Yes, I usually do’.

title: Prepositions of Time / Preposiciones de tiempo
bridge: Ingliffii keessatti, preposiciones de tiempo (at, in, on) barbaachisaa ta’an malee tokko tokkoon qabu barbaachisaa Afaan Ispaaniyitti hin danda’u. Fakkeenya, ‘on Monday’ (el lunes) jechuudha; ‘in the morning’ (por la mañana) jechuudhaan malee ‘at night’ (por la noche) jechuudha. Afaan Ispaaniyyitti ‘en’ kana ‘a’ barbaachisaa dhaabbataa ta’an isaan irraa malee barbaachisaa kan qaban hin dandeenyu. Fakkeenyaa: Ingliffii keessatti, preposiciones de tiempo tokko tokkoon barbaachisaa sirrii ta’an qaba: sa’aa (at), guyyaa (on), jechuunis masa/sani/hojii (in).
rule: Ingliffii keessatti, preposiciones de tiempo utuu ta’an qaban: ‘at’ sa’aa ta’an qaban jechuunis sa’aa ballaa (at 5 o’clock, at midnight, at noon), ‘on’ guyyaa jechuunis guyyaa fi caqixxa (on Monday, on July 4th, on my birthday), ‘in’ hojiin guyyaa (excepto ‘at night’), masa, sani, hojii jechuunis hojjechuu dhaabachuu (in the morning, in July, in 2024, in summer). Preposiciones de tiempo ‘today’, ‘yesterday’, ‘tomorrow’, ‘this’, ‘that’, ‘every’ jechuunis hin qabne. ‘At’ kanarraa ‘day’ hin jiran ‘at Christmas’ jechuudhaan malee ‘on Christmas day’ jechuudha.

title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, when, if / Konjanshanochi: fi, laaki, yoo, sababii, guyyaa, yoo
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, konjanshanochi afaan Isbaanichii dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba. Fakkeenyaaf, 'but' haala dhaabachuu fi 'pero' dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, 'but' komma hin kennamne garuu, lamaa qoosaa tokkoon godheeraa qaba’uu dhiisuu wajjin, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti komma kennamu. ‘Because’ fi ‘when’ lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti komma kennamu. ‘If’ shartii adabbii ‘si’ dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, shartii adabbii A2 keessatti subjunctive hin kennamne garuu, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti kennamu.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, konjanshanochi lamaa qoosaa, godharratti yookiin qoosaa tokkoon godheeraa qaba’uu dhiisuu wajjin. Konjanshanochi guyyaa kan danda’an: 
- 'and' (fi) maaliifama. 
- 'but' (laaki) haala dhaabachuu. 
- 'or' (yoo) akkasumas miidhaa qaba. 
- 'because' (sababii) sababii yookiin dalilaa qaba. 
- 'when' (guyyaa) guyyaa qaba. 
- 'if' (yoo) shartii qaba. 

Lamaa qoosaa tokkoon godheeraa qaba’uudha. komma konjanshanoo kennitanii wajjin (fakkeenya: 'I like tea, but she likes coffee.'). Lamaa qoosaa hincinoo garuu, komma hin kennamneefi. 

Miidhaa dursuu: 
- 'Because' 'why' godhataa deebitanii wajjin. 'Because' lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, afaan Ingilizii keessatti qaamaa hin kennamneefi. 
- 'When' lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, afaan Ingilizii keessatti qaamaa hin kennamneefi. 
- 'If' shartii qaba; shartii tokkoon (yoo + aada, dhaabbata), 'will' shartii keessatti hin kennamneefi. 

Akkaataa: 
- 'But' fi 'although' garuu hin kennamne garuu, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti 'pero aunque' jedhanii wajjin. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, tokkoon hin kennamneefi. 
- 'And' lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, afaan Ingilizii keessatti qaamaa hin kennamneefi. 
- Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, 'that' konjanshanoo hin kennamne garuu, afaan Isbaanichii keessatti 'que' jedhanii wajjin.

examples.note: 'But' haala dhaabachuu wajjin, 'pero' dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, komma hin kennamne garuu, lamaa qoosaa hincinoo wajjin.

examples.original: You can have tea or coffee.
examples.translation: Shay yoo hin miidhina haala bilinoo dhorgama.
examples.note: 'Or' akkasumas miidhaa qaba wajjin, 'o' afaan Isbaanichii dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba.

examples.original: She cries because she is happy.
examples.note: 'Because' sababii qaba wajjin. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, komma hin kennamne garuu, lamaa qoosaa hin kennamneefi.
'When' guyyaa qaba wajjin. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, aadaa hojii guyyaa dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba, afaan Isbaanichii dhaabbataa hin hojjenneefi.

examples.original: When it rains, we stay at home.
examples.phonetic: /wen ɪt reɪnz wiː steɪ æt hoʊm/
examples.note: 'When' lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, komma kennitanii wajjin. Aadaa hojii guyyaa dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba, afaan Isbaanichii dhaabbataa hin hojjenneefi.

examples.original: If you are tired, go to bed.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ɑːr ˈtaɪərd ɡoʊ tuː bed/
examples.translation: Yoo harkaa keessan, mana dhiheessuu danda’e.
examples.note: 'If' shartii haala dhaabachuu wajjin. Shartii 'if' lamaa qoosaa hin kennamne garuu, komma kennitanii wajjin.

examples.original: I will come if you invite me.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kʌm ɪf juː ɪnˈvaɪt miː/
examples.note: Shartii tokkoon keessatti, 'if' keessatti 'will' hin kennamneefi.

examples.original: If you study, you will pass.
examples.translation: Yoo bara baraadhu, mana hin baraneefi.
examples.note: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, aadaa hojii shartii keessatti, aadaa dhaabbataa hojjennee maleeshaa akkasumas miidhaa qaba. Afaan Isbaanichii keessatti, aadaa dhaabbataa hin hojjenneefi.

title: Present Perfect Basics / Lafa qofa qabdu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, present perfect (I have eaten) mana hidhaa qofa qabduu kan hin argamuufi godhaa akka ta’ee itti dhaga’u godhaa qofa qabduu (he comido) hin jiru. Akkasumas, present perfect kan ta’ee afaan Ispeenichii keessatti mana hidhaa qofa qabduu hin argamu godhaa qofa qabduu (comí) hin jiru. Fakkeenya keessaa tokko: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, present perfect mana dhaabbata dura hin kennamu ‘yesterday’ kana ‘last year’ hin jiru; gara qofa qabduu (past simple) deebi’ee jira. ‘Already’, ‘just’ fi ‘yet’ seera qofa qabduu irra deebisuu dha.
rule: Present perfect HAVE (have/has) + lafa qofa qabduu (past participle) keessaa godhamu. Qajeelfama biraa keessatti, lafa qofa qabduu lafa qofa (past tense) dura godhamu (-ed: work -> worked). Qajeelfama lafaa keessumaa, lafa qofa qabduu lafa qofa (past tense) hin godhamne (go -> gone, see -> seen). 1) Mana hidhaa qofa qabduu kan hin argamu godhaa qofa qabduu (e.g., I have visited Paris). 2) Mana hidhaa qofa qabduu kan godhaa qofa qabduu argamu (e.g., I have lost my keys). 3) ‘Already’ (dhufuu), ‘just’ (dhuma), ‘yet’ (kanatti) guyyaa walitti dhiisuu fi guutanii keessatti. 4) ‘For’ fi ‘since’ duraajjii godhaa qofa qabduu (e.g., I have lived here for 10 years). Guyyaa walitti dhiisuu keessatti, qajeelfamni baafachuu qabda. Guutanii keessatti: I have not (haven't) finished. ‘Yesterday’, ‘last week’ fi miraan qofa qabduu kan argamu godhaa qofa qabduu (past simple) deebi’ee jira, present perfect hin jiru.

concept_examples.text: I have eaten breakfast.
She has visited Mexico.
We haven't finished our homework yet.
Have you ever seen a shark?

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispeenichii keessatti ‘lo he visto ayer’ jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti present perfect mana dhaabbata dura hin kennamu ‘yesterday’ hin jiru. Mana hidhaa qofa qabduu kan argamu godhaa qofa qabduu (past simple) deebi’ee jira (saw). ‘Have seen’ jechuu mana dhaabbata dura hin kennamu godhaa qofa qabduu argamuu dha.

examples.note: ‘Have’ kan ‘I've’ jechuu afaan Ingilizii keessatti tokko tokko irra deebisuu dha: I've finished.
‘Has’ namni tokko tokko (he, she, it) irra deebisuu dha.
Guutanii ‘haven't’ (have not) kana ‘hasn't’ (has not) jechuudha.
Guyyaa walitti dhiisuu keessatti, qajeelfamni fi qajeelfamni baafachuu qabda: Have you...?
Guyyaa mana dhiphamne hin qabne; mana hidhaa qofa qabduu kan argamuu dha.
Lafa qofa qabduu ‘eat’ qajeelfama lafaa keessuu dha: ‘eaten’.

examples.original: Have you ever seen a ghost?
examples.note: Guyyaa walitti dhiisuu keessatti ‘ever’ deebi’ee jira.
Fakkeenya qofa qabduu kan argamuu dha: ishee hin kennu.
‘Just’ qajeelfamni fi lafa qofa qabduu irra deebisuu dha.

examples.original: I have lived here for five years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lɪvd hɪr fɔːr faɪv jɪrz/
examples.translation: Yeroo limoodu sana keessatti kan jirte.
examples.note: ‘For’ duraajjii godhaa qofa qabduu (dura hin jiru) irra deebisuu dha.

title: Imperatives (Affirmative and Negative) / Gaaffiiwwan (Guddaa fi Naannawaa)
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, gaaffiiwwan barbaachisaa ta'ee jiraatu qabnaa akkasumas akkan itti dhufan irratti argamsiisuu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenishii keessatti garuu, gaaffiiwwan barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a; akkasumas akkan itti dhufan irratti argamsiisuu danda'a. Fakkeenya: 'habla' (ati) fi 'hable' (zaagaa) afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti 'speak' jechuudha. Akkasumas, gaaffiiwwan naannawaa afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti 'don't' + gaafata jechuudha, afaan Ispeenishii keessatti garuu 'no' + gaaffiiwwan jechuudha. Haala dhiisee: 'doesn't' akkasumas barbaachisaa ta'e hin jiru; 'don't' akkasumas barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a.
rule: Gaaffiiwwan afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a (infinitive without 'to'). Gaaffiiwwan kun immoo amarchi, seenaa, haala uume fi haala sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a. Fakkeenya: 'Open the door', 'Listen to me'. Gaaffiiwwan naannawaa keessatti, 'don't' (ama 'do not' haala uumee keessatti) gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a: 'Don't open the door', 'Don't worry'. Akkasumas, 'let's' + gaafata jechuudha haala sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a (e.g., 'Let's go'). Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, afaan Ispeenishii hin qotolsu, gaaffiiwwan haala uumee (fakkeenya 'que te mejores') haala sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu hin danda'in, haala kunis sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a.

concept_examples.text: Open the window, please.
Don't touch that!
Let's go to the park.
Please, close the door.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Ispeenishii dubbiftuu afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti 'don't' hinneessu 'to' fayyadamiisu dubbiftan irratti deebi'ee ta'e jedhanii danda'a. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, 'don't' hinneessu gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a 'to' hin jiran.

examples.note: Gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenishii keessatti, 'siéntate' jechuudhaan barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraataa.
Gaaffiiwwan guddaa akkasumas ati fi zaagaa wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a. 'Listen' hinneessu 'to' fayyadamiisu hin jiran gaaffiiwwan keessatti.

Gaafata 'come' barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenishii keessatti 'venir' jechuudhaan barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraataa, afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu hin jiran.
Gaaffiiwwan naannawaa keessatti 'don't' gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a. Afaan Ispeenishii keessatti 'no' + gaaffiiwwan jechuudhaan danda'a.
'Be' gaafataa ta'eettii jiraataa, gaaffiiwwan naannawaa keessatti 'don't be' jechuudhaan danda'a.
'Worry' gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a; 'to' hin jiran.
'Let's' jechuudhaan 'let us' fayyadamiisuu danda'a. Haala sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a dubbiftan irratti jiraatanii akkasumas irraa ta'e jedhanii danda'a.

Afaan Ispeenishii keessatti 'veamos' (subjuntivo) ama 'vamos a ver' jechuudhaan danda'a, afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu 'let's' + gaafataa barbaachisaa ta'eettii jiraatanii wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a.
'Let's' naannawaa 'let's not + gaafata' jechuudhaan danda'a. Kun qorataa sirrii dhiisuu wajjin tokko tokko dhaga'uu danda'a.

title: Count and Uncount Nouns / Qabxii lammi fi qabxii hin lammiin
bridge: Afaan Oromo, fardii qabxii lammi fi qabxii hin lammiin kan danda'a, garu qorichaa akkas kan danda'u. Fakkeenya, 'sangaa' jedhanii qabxii lammi, 'sanga' jedhanii qabxii hin lammiin dha. Fardii kana malee, qabxii hin lammiin afaan Ingiliffaa 'a/an' yookiin 'one' hin qabaniin, afaan Oromo garu 'tokko' yookiin 'obboleessan' dubbatan.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa, qabxii lammi (count nouns) singular yookiin plural kan danda'u fi qabaniifachuu danda'u (one apple, two apples). Qabxii hin lammiin (uncount nouns) plural hin qabaniin fi hin qabaniifachuu danda'u (water, rice, information). Qabxii hin lammiin qabaachuun, 'some', 'any', 'much', yookiin 'a glass of' yookiin 'a piece of' dubbatan. Qabxii lammiin 'a/an' singular, 'many' plural, fi 'few' qixxa'ee dubbatan. Qabxii hin lammiin 'much' fi 'little' dubbatan. 'The' dubbii qabaniifachuu lammi, 'a/an' dubbii qabaniifachuu hin lammiin. Fakkeenya, 'chicken' mana dhiheessan yookiin mana muca dhiheessan qabachuu danda'u.

concept_examples.text: I need some water.
She has two apples.
Do you have any information?
He bought a piece of bread.

common_error.wrong: I have a good news for you.
common_error.correct: I have good news for you.
common_error.correct_alt: I have some good news for you.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Ingiliffaa, 'news' qabxii hin lammiin, 'a' hin qabaniin. Afaan Espanii 'una noticia' jedhanii akkas dubbatanii erga, barreeffame tokko tokko akkas akkan dubbatan. Akkas akkan dubbatanii erga, 'some' yookiin 'news' hin qabaniin dubbatan.

examples.note: 'A' qonsonsantii dhaabbataa akkan dubbatan.
Plural '-s' qabaachuun dubbatan.
'An' vowelii dhaabbataa akkan dubbatan.
'Water' plural hin qabaniin.

examples.translation: Isheen dubbii tokko tokko irraa kennitan.
examples.note: 'Some' qixxa'ee hin taane dubbatan.
'Any' galateera akkan dubbatan.

examples.original: I need a glass of milk.
examples.note: Qabxii hin lammiin qabaachuun, mataduu + 'of' dubbatan.

examples.original: She has a lot of friends.
examples.note: 'A lot of' qabxii lammi fi qabxii hin lammiin dubbatan.

examples.original: There is little sugar in the coffee.

examples.note: 'Little' qabxii hin lammiin, 'few' qabxii lammiin dubbatan.

title: Some and Any / Lammi, Mana (afi qoratawwanachuu)
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, haa ta'e ‘lammi’, ‘mana’ jew ‘qorata’ jedhamu dubbatan girchirratti, seerri dubbatan jechuudha. Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, ‘some’ fi ‘any’ irra deebisu dubba qabduu fi dubbifama tokko irra caalaa ta’e. Deebii tokko akkas jedha: afaan Ispaanii dubbatan ‘some’ dubbatan girmaataa fi ‘any’ dubbatan seerri irra deebisu godhanii afaan Ispaanii irra caalaa ta’e; lakin afaan Ingiliffii keessatti seera akkas miti. Afurku, dubbatan seerri ‘any’ mana irra deebisu godhaa ta’e.
rule: ‘Some’ (afi qoratawwanachuu: somebody, someone, something, somewhere) dubbatan girmaataa fi dubbatan girmaataa irra deebinew; mana qorataa fi mana qorataa irra deebinew akkasumas girma goonee irra deebinew. ‘Any’ (afi qoratawwanachuu: anybody, anyone, anything, anywhere) dubbatan seerri fi dubbatan seerri irra deebinew, akkasumas dubbatan girmaataa mana irra deebinew ‘mana qorata’ jew ‘qorata qofa’ jedhamu. Qoratawwan achi irra deebisu seera qoratawwanachuu irra deebisuudha. Nama barumsaa qaba dubbatan ‘some’ barumsaa qabaa fi ‘any’ barumsaa qabaa; nama barumsaa qaban qofa dubbatan ‘some’ jew ‘any’ barumsaa qabaa seera dubbifama tokko irra caalaa ta’e. ‘No’ fi ‘any’ dubbatan tokko keessatti hin kennamne; ‘no’ + nama jew ‘not... any’ jedhaa.

concept_examples.text: I have some money in my wallet.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv sʌm ˈmʌni ɪn maɪ ˈwɔːlɪt/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any questions?
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈɪznt ˈɛni mɪlk ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

concept_examples.text: Would you like something to drink?

common_error.explanation: Dubbatan seerri keessatti, afaan Ispaanii ‘no tengo algo de dinero’ jew ‘no tengo nada’ jedha; lakin afaan Ingiliffii keessatti ‘not’ + ‘some’ miti. Dubbatan seerri keessatti ‘any’ irra deebinew akkasumas ‘no’ + nama jedhaa. ‘Some’ dubbatan girmaataa fi dubbatan girmaataa irra deebisu godhaa ta’e.

levels.label: Some and Any with Countable and Uncountable Nouns
levels.translation: Lammi fi Mana nama barumsaa qaba fi nama barumsaa qaban qofa

examples.note: Barumsaa qabaa qaba. Afaan Ispaanii keessatti ‘lammi’ dubbatan girmaataa irra deebisu godha.
Dubbatan seerri keessatti, barumsaa qabaa qabaa ‘any’ irra deebinew.
Nama barumsaa qaban qofa dubbatan girmaataa keessatti, ‘some’ qorata qofa irra deebisu godha.
Dubbatan seerri umrii keessatti, nama barumsaa qaban qofa ‘any’ irra deebinew.
Lammi dubbatan girmaataa.

title: Much, Many, A lot of / Miilaa
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, guyyaa mana ‘much’ kana ‘many’ hinqabne garuu, qabeessa sirrii kana qabeessa addaa ta’e malee, guyyaa mana qabeessa sirrii ta’e. Kanarrissaan akkas ilaalchisee jira achi, garuu barbaachisaa akkumaadha. ‘Many’ dhaabbata sirrii qabduu (m. ‘books’), ‘much’ dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu (m. ‘water’), ‘a lot of’ garuu lamaanii. Akkasumas ‘much’ dhaabbata sirrii qabduu barbaachisaa hundaa’eera. Hanga ‘much’ fi ‘many’ seeraa walii fi seeraa galchi keessatti argamuu.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, ‘much’, ‘many’ fi ‘a lot of’ miilaa hinbarbu. ‘Many’ dhaabbata sirrii qabduu barbaachisaa (m. ‘books’, ‘cars’, ‘friends’). ‘Much’ dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu barbaachisaa (m. ‘water’, ‘time’, ‘money’). Seeraa walii keessatti, ‘a lot of’ (kana ‘lots of’ duubii walii) lamaanii barbaachisaa. Seeraa walii fi seeraa galchi keessatti, ‘much’ fi ‘many’ barbaachisu. ‘How much’ miilaa dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu barbaachisu (m. ‘How much water?’), ‘how many’ miilaa dhaabbata sirrii qabduu barbaachisu (m. ‘How many books?’). ‘Much’ fi ‘many’ dhaabbata sirrii tokko hinbarbu. ‘Too much’, ‘too many’, ‘so much’, ‘so many’ barbaachisu. Seeraa walii keessatti, ‘much’ duubii walii fi duubii baay’ee barbaachisaa (m. ‘There is much work’). A2 keessatti, seeraa galchi fi seeraa walii keessatti barbaachisaa fi ‘a lot of’ seeraa walii keessatti barbaachisaa hordofsuu barbaadduu kan danda’u. ‘Much’ fi ‘many’ ‘no’ hin jiran barbaachisuu akkasumas maaliifi (m. ‘not much’ kana ‘not many’).

examples.translation: Manaa jiraachuu qabduu hanga saaxiloonni hin jiran.

Seeraa galchi keessatti, ‘many’ dhaabbata sirrii qabduu barbaachisaa.

Barumsaa dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu. Seeraa walii keessatti, ‘much’ dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu barbaachisaa.

examples.note: ‘Too much’ ‘shanii hinka’ee’ jechuu danda’a.
Qajeelfama dhaabbata sirrii hinqabduu, garuu qajeelfama tokko tokko qabduu danda’a.

title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that / Qabxiiwwan walitti: who, which, that
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, 'que' kana qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, 'who' (hundaa’eera) fi 'which' (qabxiiwwan) qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera. 'That' hundaa’eera fi qabxiiwwan qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera. Haa ta’u: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera qabduu hin dandeenye, laakin Afaan Ispaanii keessatti qabduu dandeenyu. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, 'what' qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera hin jiru; 'that' fi 'which' qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera.
rule:
Qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera sadarkaa lamaanii hundaa’eera fi qabxiiwwan lamaanii tokkoo malee hin kennamne. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti:

- **who** hundaa’eera (sujeto fi objeto) fi, afaan akkaataa keessatti, hayyamaan tokko tokkoon nama qabduu danda'a.
- **which** qabxiiwwan, hayyamaan fi mirkanaa.
- **that** hundaa’eera fi qabxiiwwan qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera, haasa’aa qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera (restrictivas).

Qorattoota guddaa: [sustaantivo] + [qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera] + [cláusula].

Miskaa’ii:
- The man **who** lives next door is a doctor. (Mana hundaa’eera bakkaa keessan deebii argama.)
- The book **which** I bought is interesting. (Kitaaba kennee dhufne guddaa ta’e.)
- The dog **that** barks a lot is mine. (Kalaqaan barbaachisu dhaabbata keessan argama.)

**Laggeessa Afaan Ispaanii keessaa:**
- 'What' qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera hin kennamne (Afaan Ispaanii keessatti 'qué' qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera, laakin Afaan Ingilizii keessatti 'what' 'lo que' jechuu dhaabbata hin kennamne).
- 'Who/which/that' qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera hin kennamne, sababa verbii hundaa’eera qabduu danda'a.
- Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, qorattoota hundaa’eera + verbo jechuu kan hin qabne, Afaan Ispaanii jechuun hin argamu (miskaa’iin, 'El hombre que vive aquí' -> 'The man who lives here', 'The man who here lives' hin jiru).

**Qorattoota fi qajeelfama:** Qajeelfama hin jiran. 'That' hundaa’eera fi qabxiiwwan qabxiiwwan walitti argamanii hundaa’eera. 'Who' hundaa’eera. 'Which' qabxiiwwan. Afaan Ingilizii sirnaa keessatti, 'that' afaan akkaataa keessatti miidhaa’eera, laakin 'who' fi 'which' miidhaa’uu dhaabachuu danda'a.
